newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ALBANIA, Feb 17 - Durres - Seven vessels discharging of which 2 bagged cement, 2 bagged wheat flour, 1 chemicals, 1 bulk cement, 1 bagged sugar. 5 Vessels awaiting berth in roads for discharging of which 2 bagged rice, 1 bagged sugar, 1 nitrates, 1 bagged wheat flour.

BULGARIA, Feb 17 - Varna - East - 2 Vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 4 awaiting orders. West - 10 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 8 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Lesport - 1 Vessel loading at berth. Bourgas - East - 13 Vessels due, 10 loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 13 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 4 under repair/drydock. West - 5 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth.

Bourgas - 21 Vessels operating of which 13 loading, 5 fertiliser, 1 general, 1 zinc, 1 timber, 1 clinker, 1 coils, 1 metals, 1 coke, 1 benzene. 6 Discharging, 1 fertiliser, 2 fishmeal, 1 coal, 1 iron ore, 1 copper/zinc concentrate. 2 Discharging/loading, 1 salt/fertiliser, 1 sugar/metals. 16 Vessels waiting in roads of which to load, 1 benzene, 1 chemicals, 1 general, 1 copper concentrate, 1 copper, 1 coils, 1 cars. 2 To discharge, 1 sugar, 1 iron ore. 2 To discharge/load containers. 4 Awaiting orders, 1 to discharge/load containers/metals. 13 Vessels due, 3 to load timber, coils, fertiliser. 5 To discharge of which 4 coils, 1 tobacco. 3 To discharge/load containers, 2 to discharge/load containers/general, pipes/general.

Varna - 36 Vessels operation of which 24 loading, 2 glass, 2 cement, 1 cigarette, 1 cellulose, 1 kaoline, 4 soda, 2 tsp, 2 fertiliser, 2 clinker, 4 sas, 1 glass/general,trucks, 1 vegetable oil, 1 frozen chickens. 6 Discharging, 1 sugar, 3 phosphorite, 1 coal, 1 coke. 5 Discharging/loading containers, 1 discharging/loading trucks/containers. 17 Vessels waiting in roads of which 2 to load, 1 sas, 1 fertiliser. 1 To discharge/load containers. 14 Cargo not nominated.

CROATIA, Feb 17 - Rijeka - Two vessels discharging at berth, 5 loading at berth, 3 anchored, 5 under repair/drydock, 3 due, delays expected. Zadar - One vessel discharging at berth, 1 loading at berth. Sibenik - Two vessels loading at berth, 1 due, delays expected. Split - Two vessels discharging at berth, 1 under repair/drydock. Pula, Rasa, Ploce, Dubrovnik - No vessels in ports.

CYPRUS, Feb 18 - Limassol - Vessels due 19/2, 1 container vessel, 1 conventional, 3 passenger vessels, no delays expected. 2 Conventional vessels discharging at berth, 2 vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge/load. Larnaca - Vessels due 19/2, 2 containers, 2 conventional vessels, no delays expected. 1 Container vessel discharging/loading at berth, 2 conventional vessels discharging at berth.

ESTONIA, Feb 17 - Tallinn - City port - 3 Vessels due, 3 loading at berth of which 1 mop, 1 steel billets, 1 steel coils. 1 Waiting at anchorage to load, 1 liner vessel, 1 awaiting orders. Kopli - 5 Vessels due, 3 loading at berth of which 1 fertiliser, 2 sawn timber, 1 vessel discharging meat at berth. Parnu - 5 Vessels due, 4 loading at berth of which 2 timber, 1 briquette, 1 wood granules. Muuga - 6 Vessels loading at berth of which 3 fuel oil, 1 boards, 1 fertiliser, 1 container vessel, 1 container vessel discharging at berth.

ITALY, Feb 18 - Naples, Gaeta, Salerno - No vessels in roads. Genoa commercial port - One vessel in roads, no delays. 33 Vessels berthed, 5 in drydock. Multedo oil harbour - No vessels in roads, no delays, no vessels berthed. Savona - No vessels in roads, no delays, 3 vessels berthed. Vado Ligure - No vessels in roads, no delays, 2 vessels berthed. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays. 8 Vessels berthed, 5 under repair/drydock. Leghorn - Four vessels in roads, no delays, 40 vessels berthed. Civitavecchia - Four vessels in roads. Gaeta, Naples, Salerno, Palermo, Ancona/Falconara - No vessels in roads, no delays. Augusta oil harbour - Four vessels in roads, 2 berthed. Syracuse oil harbour - One vessel in roads, no delays, 1 vessel berthed. Sarroch - Four vessels in roads, 4 berthed. Ravenna - Seven vessels in roads. Venice - Three vessels in roads. Trieste - No vessels in roads.

LITHUANIA, Feb 17 - Klaipeda - Vessels loading in port, 1 sunflower pellets, 6 fertiliser, 3 metal, 2 timber, 1 scrap, 1 pig iron. Discharging, 7 fish, 1 each bananas, 1 drinks, 1 citrus, 1 sugar. 1 Vessel loading/discharging, 8 in roads, 30 due.

POLAND, Feb 18 - Gdynia - 13 Vessels operating, 8 loading at berth (3 general cargo, 1 coal, 2 steel). 5 Vessels discharging at berth (2 general cargo, 2 bulk, 1 grain). 3 Vessels under repair/drydock, 17 due. Gdansk - 12 Vessels operating. 8 Loading at berth (2 bulk, 4 coal, 2 general cargo). 4 Discharging at berth (2 bulk, 2 tankers). 2 Vessels under repair/drydock, 11 due.

PORTUGAL, Feb 17 - Leixoes - Vessels operating, 11 general cargo, 3 container vessels, 1 general cargo and 1 container vessel awaiting berth totalling 37,570 dwt (1 large size, 1 handy size). Places vacant, 3 piers with cranes, 1 pier without crane. Feb 18 - Setubal - Two vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 5 under repair/drydock. Vessels due, 12 for discharging, 6 for loading, 1 for repair/drydock. Sines - Vessels operating, 1 discharging bulk rice, 1 loading propylene, 1 loading gasoline/gasoil/jet fuel. Vessels waiting, 2 to load propylene, 1 to load propane, 1 to load aromatics mixture. Vessels due, 2 to discharge coal, 1 to discharge crude, 1 to discharge metallic structures, 1 to load propane.

ROMANIA, Feb 18 - Constantza - 34 Vessels operating of which 11 generals loading, 13 bulkers (9 loading, 4 discharging), 5 bagged chemicals loading, 1 tanker discharging, 2 bagged cement loading, 2 containers loading/discharging. 4 Vessels waiting in roads of which 1 bagged chemicals for loading, 2 tankers for discharging, 1 bagged cement for loading. Constantza Sud (Agigea) - Five generals loading, 1 bagged chemicals loading. Mangalia - No vessels in port. Midia - Four livestock carriers of which 3 loading, 1 discharging.

RUSSIA, Feb 17 - BALTIC PORTS - St. Petersburg - 23 Vessels operating of which 17 loading, 8 non-ferrous, 1 each paper, cellulose, general, scrap, containers, 4 fertiliser. 6 Discharging of which 2 rice, 2 frozen chicken, 2 containers. 12 Vessels awaiting operations, 19 due.

FAR EAST PORTS - Vladistok - Feb 18 - 12 Vessels in port of which 1 passenger. 5 Vessels loading (2 metal, 3 timber), 1 container discharging/loading, 5 vessels waiting. Nakhodka - 10 Vessels in port of which 7 loading (1 metal, 4 timber, 2 general cargo). 3 Vessels waiting. Vostochniy - Five vessels in port of which 3 loading (2 timber, 1 coal), 2 vessels waiting. Posyet - One vessel loading metal. Zarubino - No vessels. No delays in ports. No congestion.

BLACK SEA - Novorossiysk - Feb 18 - 20 Vessels opering of which 14 loading, 1 cement, 7 steel, 1 coal, 1 aluminium, 1 saltpetre, 1 cars, 2 fertiliser. 5 Discharging, 1 rice, 1 various, 2 citrus, 1 aluminium. 1 Discharging/loading containers. 21 Vessels waiting in roads of which 13 to load, 5 steel, 1 zinc, 2 copper, 1 aluminium, 1 saltpetre, 2 scrap, 1 vehicles. 8 To discharge, 1 sugar, 4 rice, 2 citrus, 1 maize. 41 Vessels due of which 33 to load, 1 cement, 4 scrap, 14 steel, 3 copper cathodes, 1 copper, 4 aluminium, 1 fertiliser, 1 saltpre, 1 paper, 2 coal, 1 molasses. 6 To discharge, 2 sugar, 1 equipment, 3 luggage. 2 To discharge/load containers. Oil terminal, 3 Tankers loading crude oil, 11 tankers in roads to load crude and diesel oil, 4 tankers due to load crude, fuel oil.

NORTHERN BASIN - Murmansk - Seven vessels operating of which 3 alumina, 1 npk, 1 apatite, 2 cabotage, 1 alumina discharger waiting. 17 Vessels due during the week of which 12 loaders (6 apatite, 1 npk, 1 steel, 2 cabotage, 1 non-ferrous metal, 1 coa. 5 Dischargers (3 alumina, 2 cabotage).

SLOVENIA, Feb 17 - Koper - 13 Vessels berthed of which 3 containers loading/discharging, 1 bulk carrier loading coal, 3 bulk carriers discharging alumina, coal, perlite, 1 general cargo loading aluminum, 2 ferries loading/discharging, 3 livestock vessels loading bulls. 11 Vessels due of which 2 containers, 3 car carriers, 2 ferries, 3 general cargo to load sawn timber, steel products, 1 bulk carrier, no delays expected.

SPAIN, Feb 17 - La Coruna - A truckers strike commenced on 10/2 affecting the discharge operation of grain. The strike is taking place in and outside the port installations. At present there is no foreseeable solution to the strike despite daily meetings between the ministry and labour unions. Feb 18 - Aviles - Five vessels in port of which 3 loading (1 zinc, 1 steel, 1 sulphuric acid). 2 Vessels discharging (1 coils, 1 tar). Gijon - Six vessels in port of which 2 loading (1 cement, 1 sugar). 4 Discharging (2 coal, 1 fuel oil, 1 paper reels. No delays/congestion in the ports. Sagunto - 13 Vessels operating in port of which 3 discharging/loading general cargo, 7 discharging steel products, 1 discharging bananas in boxes, 1 discharging/loading general cargo, 1 loading fertiliser. No vessels berthed outside commercial wharf, no berthing delays.

CADIZ - 11 Vessels operating of which 4 ro-ro, 1 sand, 1 clinker, 5 under repair, no delays. Pasajes - 22 Vessels in port of which 8 discharging scrap, 5 discharging steel, 1 each discharging magnesite, sawn timber, granite, general cargo, china clay, mineral, coal, cold fish. 1 Discharging/loading cars, no delays. Santander - Vessels loading, 1 sugar, 1 sodium phosphate, 1 cement. Unloading, 1 molasses, 2 scrap, 1 cars, 1 coal, 1 soya beans, 1 paper reels. No vessels anchored, no delays expected.

TURKEY, Feb 17 - Istanbul - Haydarpasa - 7 Vessels operating of which 3 containers, 3 dry cargo, 1 ro-ro, no berthing delays. Galata - 8 Vessels operating, congestion. Ambarli - 14 Vessels operating, no berthing delays.

UKRAINE, Feb 17 - Mariupol - Four vessels loading at berth (fertiliser, metal products, sulphur, coal). 1 Vessel discharging chrome ore at berth, 3 waiting at anchorage to load (metal products), 1 awaiting orders at anchorage (fertiliser). 11 Floating storehouses (fertiliser, sulphur), 1 vessel under repair/drydock. 13 Vessels due (general cargo, metal products, clay, metal coal, alina, containers, fertiliser). Kerch - One vessel loading manganese ore at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load manganese ore, 3 under repair/drydock, 2 due (manganese ore, metal products).

Berdiansk - Four vessels loading at berth (sunflower seeds, metal products). 2 Vessels discharging at berth (oranges, coke). Feb 18 - Mariupol - Four vessels loading of which 2 fertiliser, 1 slabs/pipes/pig iron, 1 cargo not nominated. 3 Vessels waiting in roads to load slabs, 2 steel coils. 13 Vessels due of which 6 to load, 1 steel, 2 coal, 1 pipes, 2 fertiliser. 3 To discharge, 1 equipment, 1 miscellaneous, 1 aluminium. 4 To discharge/load containers.

Odessa - 10 Vessels operating of which 5 loading, 3 metal, 1 sunflowerseeds, 1 diesel oil, 2 under repair, 2 waiting, 1 passenger vessel. 7 Vessels waiting in roads of which 6 to load, 5 sunflowerseeds, 1 oil, 1 waiting. 15 Vessels due of which 13 to load, 9 metal, 2 sunflowerseeds, 1 chemicals, 1 fertiliser. 1 To discharge citrus, 1 to discharge/load containers.

YUGOSLAVIA, Feb 18 - Bar - Five vessels berthed of which 2 discharging bananas, 1 discharging wheat, 1 discharging anodes, 1 loading steel coils, no delays. Zelenika, Bijela - Three vessels in port, 1 under repair.
